quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: Which traffic light means you must stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe?
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. You must stop completely, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving to an unfamiliar area, what should you do?

options.text: Depend on road signs to find your way
Only have a general idea of where you are going
Always choose the most direct route

questions.explanation: Plan your trip before you start driving. Check a map to know where you are going before you leave.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. Your car should be in which lane?

options.text: The lane with the least traffic

questions.explanation: When turning left onto a one-way street, turn into the left lane. This is closest to the lane you just left.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer traveling at 55 mph may need up to ____ to stop completely.
questions.explanation: Tractor-trailers take much longer to stop than smaller cars. A fully loaded tractor-trailer needs almost 400 feet to stop when traveling at 55 mph.

questions.question: What is the minimum liability insurance required for property damage?
questions.explanation: The law requires drivers to carry liability insurance. The minimum amount for property damage is $25,000.

questions.question: Your body can process approximately how many alcoholic drinks per hour?
questions.explanation: The average person's body processes about one drink per hour. How impaired you become depends on how much you drink, how fast you drink, your body weight, whether you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: How should you check your blind spots before changing lanes?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulder

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder
questions.explanation: Always turn your head to look over your shoulder to check your blind spots before you change lanes.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with flashing red or blue lights approaches, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down and drive with caution
Pull over to the side of the road and stop
Drive to the nearest intersection and stop

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side of the road and stop
questions.explanation: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing red or blue lights, pull to the side of the road and stop. Stay stopped until the emergency vehicle passes.

questions.question: If your car starts to skid, which direction should you turn your steering wheel?

options.text: In the direction you want the vehicle to go
In the opposite direction of the skid

questions.correctAnswerText: In the direction you want the vehicle to go
questions.explanation: If your car skids, steer in the direction you want it to go. Once the car straightens out, turn the wheel back the other way.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn into a driveway, turn out of a driveway, or make a legal U-turn.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on white background
Black letters or symbols on yellow background
White letters or symbols on blue background
White letters or symbols on green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to road conditions and hazards. They are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Lanes move in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Lanes move in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Lanes move in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Lanes move in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lanes move in the same direction. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. Dashed lines mean you can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when changing lanes?

options.text: Signal as you move into the next lane.
Signal 500 feet ahead on residential streets.

questions.explanation: Other vehicles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before changing lanes. Signal 100 feet ahead on residential streets and 5 seconds ahead on freeways.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: An approaching driver does not dim their high beams. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the approaching vehicle.
Toward the right side of the road.
Toward the left side of the road.
Straight down the middle of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road to avoid being blinded by bright headlights. This helps you see the road well enough to stay on course until the other vehicle passes.

questions.question: When must you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Drive at the maximum speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep steady speed.
Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery surfaces. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: When must you yield to other drivers?

options.text: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
When another car is on your left at an unmarked intersection and you arrive at the same time.
When your traffic signal is a green arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When entering a street from a garage or alley.
questions.explanation: You must yield when entering a street from an alley, driveway, or garage. You must also yield to pedestrians crossing an intersecting sidewalk.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a road with a curb, which way should your front wheels point?

options.text: Any direction, as long as you set the parking brake.

questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn your front wheels away from the curb. When parking uphill on a road without a curb, turn your front wheels toward the road edge.
